mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 60 degrees and a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The city has announced that road construction along Highway M begins tomorrow to prepare for the new Aldi development, requiring traffic shifts for the next few weeks. Additionally, the Senior Center is looking for volunteers to help with their programs, provided you can commit to at least two shifts a month.

There is a lot going on in town today, starting with the Epic Systems User Group Meeting and yoga classes at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, you can head over to Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company for trivia nights, and look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market this Wednesday.

The Verona Police Department released their weekly report, which noted that on Saturday, August 8, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office by using a drone to locate a suspect following a vehicle rollover crash.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Caramel Chocolate Pecan.
